outcome: implemented populateShoreScene helper with material role splitting, winding reversal, and Wicked palette binding; verified via minimal translation unit compilation

implementation_details.helper: stalthos::engine::populateShoreScene(wi::scene::Scene&, const domain::ReferenceLandscape&, double resolution = 2.0, std::uint64_t seed = 1)
implementation_details.role_splitting: Partitions domain ShoreMesh by ShoreMaterial into separate RoleMeshBuilders using O(1) index remap tables, preventing unsafe indices or cross-role references
implementation_details.winding_reversal: Reverses all domain triangle indices (u0, u1, u2) -> (u0, u2, u1) so that Wicked Engine's reversed cross-product normal convention (p2 - p0) x (p1 - p0) evaluates to upward (+Y) host normals for both water surface and bed substrate

materials.water_surface: Role WaterSurface evaluated from EnvironmentPalette; configured with SHADERTYPE_WATER, tinted linear base color, refraction, transmission, double-sided false, shadows disabled
materials.wet_bed: Role CreekBed evaluated from EnvironmentPalette; darker rough opaque PBR dielectric substrate with shadows enabled
materials.wet_bank: Role WetBank evaluated from EnvironmentPalette; darkened moist riparian sediment PBR dielectric substrate with shadows enabled

implementation_details.legacy_creek: Flat legacy creek is unhandled here; root integrator will wire populateShoreScene and remove the legacy creek strip
